scope: Entry-AEE contract hardening status for horizon, role, and pocket alignment enforcement.

checks.name: short_term_vs_long_term_enforcement
checks.notes: Canonical packet contract declares trade_horizon and runtime validation enforces enum validity.

checks.name: harvest_runner_hybrid_enforcement
checks.notes: Canonical packet contract declares trade_role and runtime validation enforces HARVEST/RUNNER/HYBRID with challenger skip on invalid packet.

checks.name: pocket_alignment_enforcement
checks.notes: Runtime now rejects mismatched aee_pocket_id unless deterministic derivation is present and records derivation_used in audit telemetry.

checks.name: contract_audit_event_emission
checks.notes: Runtime now emits ENTRY_AEE_CONTRACT_AUDIT with contract_version, contract_valid, missing_fields, entry_pocket_id, aee_pocket_id, derivation_used, trade_horizon, trade_role, target_profile, and engine_path.

promotion_implication.reason: Contract enforcement is runtime-hardened. Promotion still requires wide replay compatibility and baseline-outperformance evidence.

required_next_actions: Run replay/evidence pass and verify ENTRY_AEE_CONTRACT_AUDIT events in emitted trade logs.
Keep promotion gate off until wide replay path is dataset-compatible and challenger beats baseline.
